name: stempel-kit
description: The core of the Stempel Kit for Claude Code: guard and check hooks, a spec and a plan with their lints, a test-first build with three subagents, a review in a fresh context and the red and green runs in the pull request. Extensions: stempel-kit-evidence, stempel-kit-autopilot, stempel-kit-routing, stempel-kit-improve, stempel-kit-risk, stempel-kit-onboard. Run install.sh --plugin in each project for the rules, permissions and check commands.
